novelty_basis: Elementary consequence of the fact that the centraliser of an N-cycle consists of its powers.
proof_check: written proof (proofs/paper/C06.md Theorem 4); counts 1, 2, 9, 64, 625 for N <= 5 (EXP-C06-02); awaiting independent skeptic review
statement: If (xy)z = (xz)y on Z/N and x*0 = x + 1, then x*y = x + c(y) for a function c with c(0) = 1; conversely every such operation is right-permutable and anchored. Hence there are exactly N^(N-1) anchored right-permutable magmas of size N.
title: Anchored right-permutable magmas are x*y = x + c(y); there are N^(N-1) of them
